description: Creates a new Google Spreadsheet in Drive with an optional title and folder ID or exact folder name. Multiple matching folders return choices before creation; if moving a created spreadsheet to the requested folder fails, the response reports partial success.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the new Google Sheet. If omitted, Google will create a spreadsheet with a default name like 'Untitled spreadsheet'.
title.human_parameter_description: The title for the new Google Sheet. If omitted, Google will create a spreadsheet with a default name like 'Untitled spreadsheet'.

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID where the spreadsheet should be created. If provided, the spreadsheet will be moved to this folder after creation. Takes precedence over folder_name.
folder_id.human_parameter_description: Google Drive folder ID where the spreadsheet should be created

folder_name.title: Folder Name
folder_name.description: Google Drive folder name where the spreadsheet should be created. If provided and folder_id is not provided, the action will search for a folder with this exact name. If multiple folders match, you'll receive a list to choose from. If no folder matches, an error is returned.
folder_name.human_parameter_description: Google Drive folder name where the spreadsheet should be created

FolderChoice.title: FolderChoice

path.title: Path
path.description: Full path of the folder if available

FolderChoice.description: A folder choice when multiple folders with the same name are found.

GridProperties.title: GridProperties
GridProperties.description: Properties of a grid (sheet dimensions and display settings).

SheetProperties.title: SheetProperties
SheetProperties.description: Properties of a sheet (tab) within a spreadsheet.

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: The ID of the folder where the spreadsheet was created

dataSources.title: Data Sources
dataSources.description: External data sources connected to the spreadsheet.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: The URL to display/open the spreadsheet in the Google Sheets UI.

folder_name.title: Folder Name
folder_name.description: The name of the folder where the spreadsheet was created

namedRanges.title: Named Ranges
namedRanges.description: Named ranges defined in the spreadsheet.

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet; read-only. Only absent when requires_user_selection is true.

spreadsheetUrl.title: Spreadsheet Url
spreadsheetUrl.description: The URL of the spreadsheet; read-only.

matching_folders.title: Matching Folders
matching_folders.description: List of matching folders when multiple folders with the same name are found

developerMetadata.title: Developer Metadata
developerMetadata.description: Developer metadata attached to the spreadsheet.

dataSourceSchedules.title: Data Source Schedules
dataSourceSchedules.description: Data source refresh schedules in the spreadsheet.

requires_user_selection.title: Requires User Selection
requires_user_selection.description: True if multiple folders with the same name were found and user selection is required

composio_execution_message.title: Composio Execution Message
composio_execution_message.description: Additional information about the execution (e.g., partial success warnings)

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
